disease_state: Our reverse thiol-trapping analyses showed that in WT HEK293T cells, 50% of COX11 is Cu(I)·COX11 or oxidized monomeric COX11 (2AMS bound), but in COX19-KO and PET191-KO cells, COX11 is fully reduced in the apo-state (0 AMS bound) (Fig. 2B).
sample_source: We used the CRISPR-Cas9 technology to create stable human HEK293T cell line KOs for COX11, or COX19 (Supplementary Fig. 1A–D, G).
cell_line: To examine protein-protein interactions unbiasedly, we analyzed the IPs of COX11, COX19, and PET191 by LC-MS-MS.
